retained_algebraic_lemmas.statement: A nonzero rational pair in K has nonzero norm and rational inverse (a_0,-a_1)/(a_0^2-2a_1^2).
retained_algebraic_lemmas.conventions: Nonzero means the field element is nonzero; either individual rational coordinate may vanish. This is an elementary fact, not a new external arithmetic theorem.

retained_algebraic_lemmas.statement: For c in Q nonzero and F independent of v, eliminating cv-F=0 by substituting v=F/c everywhere else preserves rational solutions on the retained coordinates. Its reverse gives the initial product lift.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.proof: Restrict an old solution; reconstruct the deleted coordinate as F/c. For a product lift, evaluate each new target in order.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.conventions: The target is not X_0; substitution covers every outside occurrence; division is by a nonzero rational constant; final residual degree stays at most two.

retained_algebraic_lemmas.statement: Replacing R_i by a R_i+b R_j while retaining R_j preserves simultaneous vanishing when i differs from j and a is nonzero.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.conventions: The row coefficients are rational constants and no coordinate is changed.

retained_algebraic_lemmas.statement: Two acyclic constant-pivot defining circuits are interchangeable when their retained outputs are identical polynomials in the same external coordinates.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.proof: Evaluate either circuit uniquely from the external coordinates. Equal boundary outputs preserve every outside equation.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.conventions: Internal deleted coordinates have no outside uses; output identities and order, complete definitions, and fresh targets are checked. This does not require any input field element to be nonzero.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.scope_in_this_release: Used for exact source-circuit evaluation and fresh product lift; there are no circuit events in the final replay.

retained_algebraic_lemmas.statement: The constraint u(A^2-2B^2)=1 is equivalent on retained coordinates to As+2Bt=1 and At+Bs=0.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.proof: Forward set s=Au and t=-Bu; reverse set u=s^2-2t^2. Use (A^2-2B^2)(s^2-2t^2)=(As+2Bt)^2-2(At+Bs)^2 and reconstruct deleted lift definitions.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.conventions: A and B are rational affine expressions in retained coordinates. The removed inverse and lift targets are private. No variable denominator or additional nonvanishing premise occurs.

retained_algebraic_lemmas.statement: Retained epsilon=theta^2-2 and R(F-1)=epsilon^2 imply epsilon and R are nonzero.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.conventions: theta and all scalar coordinates are rational. The two displayed equations must remain available in the current residual system.

retained_algebraic_lemmas.statement: When u occurs only in uR=1 and the retained root-error equations prove R nonzero, delete u and that equation.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.proof: Restrict forward and reverse by u=1/R.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.conventions: u is not input zero, its complete current occurrence set is the guard row, and no premise of nonvanishing contains u. This describes the 41 comparison contact guards, not the separate scalar height guard.

retained_algebraic_lemmas.statement: Replace the private field coordinates w,h in the displayed seven-equation chart by p=yf and p^2=x-Df, retaining u,v,z,f,x,y and their other equations.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.proof: Forward set p=yf and derive h=up and fp^2=1-Df^2. Reverse the retained equations give p nonzero and fp^2=v^2(1+df), hence v nonzero; set h=up and w=up/v.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.conventions: d=3-sqrt(2), D=d^2. All old scalar coordinate pairs are distinct, the four deleted scalar coordinates are private, and p is fresh. Division by v is used only after its nonvanishing is proved.

retained_algebraic_lemmas.statement: Retain xf=1, replace p=yf and yz=-x by pz=-1, and substitute y=xp in every outside equation.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.proof: The old equations imply y=xp and pz=-1. Conversely, adjoining y=xp gives yf=p and yz=-x.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.conventions: Both rational components are substituted simultaneously in their entire occurrence set. Reject any substitution whose resulting residual degree exceeds two. No additional nonvanishing hypothesis is introduced.

retained_algebraic_lemmas.statement: The displayed seven-witness source parity block and twelve-witness nine-quadratic block have the same existential projection on the unchanged rational input b.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.proof: The source equation forces delta=1+bt^2 nonzero. Set u=U, v=2bt/delta and the displayed products. Reverse with U=t=0 if b=0, U=u and t=v/(u+b) if b is nonzero and u+b is nonzero, or U=b and t=0 if u=-b. In every case U^2=z, and the remaining source equations follow by substitution.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.conventions: All old witnesses and deleted lift targets are private. The exceptional branch may change the sign of U. The conclusion is equality of existential projections, not inverse bijections of the full private witness tuples. No theorem about the arithmetic meaning of the parity predicate is used.

retained_algebraic_lemmas.statement: Replace the expanded row PN-epsilon^2 B^2-RT^2=0 by RO=P, Q=B^2 and ON-FQ+Q-T^2=0 while retaining N and the upper norm system.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.proof: Use PN-epsilon^2 B^2-RT^2=-N(RO-P)+Q(RF-R-epsilon^2)+epsilon^2(Q-B^2)+R(ON-FQ+Q-T^2). Forward set O=P/R and Q=B^2; reverse reconstruct deleted definitions in acyclic order and use R nonzero.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.conventions: B is affine. A retained P=R^2 permits O=R. A shared Q requires equality of the complete square polynomials. Retain every definition needed outside the replaced rows and its dependencies. A square target denotes B^2, not a chosen square root. Upper norm values and the parity input are unchanged; no leaf-order or square-class invariance theorem is assumed.

retained_algebraic_lemmas.statement: Input-fixing relabeling and nonzero rational row scaling preserve solvability; the sum of the 9161 unit-weight rational squares vanishes exactly when all residuals vanish.
standard_facts: Nonzero rational rescaling preserves a zero set
A finite sum of nonnegative rational numbers is zero only when each summand is zero
retained_algebraic_lemmas.conventions: All final weights are one; the final integer residuals have degree at most two; input zero is fixed. Exact degree four and the numerical bounds require the full collected expansion, not only these zero-set observations.

retained_algebraic_lemmas.statement: Replacing an auxiliary coordinate v_old by v_new+c w everywhere, for rational c and w distinct from v, is an invertible rational change fixing the input.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.proof: The inverse is v_new=v_old-cw. Substitute simultaneously in every current incident row. The value of every other coordinate is unchanged.
retained_algebraic_lemmas.conventions: v is not input0; w may be input0. Full occurrence set must be covered and rows remain quadratic. Four actual shear events are used.

arithmetic_lemmas.label: thm:quartic-height19
arithmetic_lemmas.title: Five-contact height with exponent 19
conventions: Use the final primitive weight-two form after the finite twist, a normal L' of degree at most2304R, and det(r)=epsilon*chi_cyc in the arithmetic-Frobenius convention.
epsilon^2 factors through Gal(L'/Q), so ord(epsilon)<=2[L':Q]<=4608R. This does not bound the coefficient-field degree or replace L' with L.
Use the rational point-level model X_H=X1(N)/ker(epsilon), the entire conjugate differential space and the effective diamond group in push-pull.
A_f is a Q-isogeny factor of J_H; the inherited Hom theorem over L' then gives A times Z isogenous to J_H. Only the Jacobian needs its canonical principal polarization.
d_H<=9216*210^300*R^(19/6); retain the original stable Faltings metric and all transfer terms.

arithmetic_lemmas.label: lem:quartic-rational37
arithmetic_lemmas.title: Thirty-seven rational-target contacts
arithmetic_lemmas.statement: The 37 raw positions v/V0, u-delta*v, u-(47027*a_i+3-delta)*v detect every normalized odd contact of the common slope and eight rational target slopes. Their complete prime construction and direct heights require no denominator variable in the source.
conventions: The a_i are exactly the two coefficients of x(A),x(S),x(T),x(Z); positions are retained even when slopes or primes coincide.
D0 is a fixed common denominator chosen after the eight coefficients. Put v=V0*D0^2*p0; keep D0 fixed before the sieve box grows.
At primes dividing D0 outside S_*, both slope depths are even. Raw infinity is D0^2*p0, with odd valuation one at its assigned prime.
Use the inherited fixed-system ordinary-prime, successor, pole and squareclass theorems with their original version qualifications.
For both slope radicals to exponent e dividing nonzero N, h(a_i)<2H19*|N|^(19/e)+14 and h(x(Q))<4H19*|N|^(19/e)+30<7H19*|N|^(19/e).

arithmetic_lemmas.label: lem:quartic-reciprocal-log
arithmetic_lemmas.title: Reciprocal identity and the complete infinite-tail estimate
arithmetic_lemmas.statement: For a0=1,a1=-2/5,aj=(4j-5)*a(j-1)/(4j+1), G=sum aj*w^j, the formal identity is log_E(z)=zG(Df^2). For integers10<=e<=64 and m=ceil(e/4), L_e=zG_(m-1)(Df^2) has L_e/log_E(z) in1+p^e Z_p at every nonidentity formal point above split p>76176.
conventions: The second label lem:quartic-uniform-reciprocal labels this same lemma.
Require the identity formal branch; a small z without this hypothesis is insufficient.
The differential is4w(1-w)G'+(1+w)G=1-w. Denominator(aj) divides(4j+1)!, so the estimate includes the entire infinite tail, including j with p-divisible denominator.
At v(z)=r>=1, the absolute error has valuation at least(4m+1)r.

arithmetic_lemmas.label: lem:quartic-reciprocal-nonzero
arithmetic_lemmas.title: Global reciprocal-polynomial nonvanishing
arithmetic_lemmas.statement: For every f in K and integer J>=2, G_J(Df^2) is nonzero.
conventions: Use v(a+b*sqrt2)=min(v2(a),v2(b)+1/2), v(D)=0 and v(aj)=1 for j>=1.
If v(f)>=0 the constant term is uniquely least. If v(f)<0 the last term is uniquely least, with valuation at most1-J<0. No good reduction at2 is assumed.

arithmetic_lemmas.label: lem:quartic-selective-local
arithmetic_lemmas.title: Local conclusions for full and beta-only comparators
arithmetic_lemmas.statement: At every odd raw-contact valuation above p>76176, the full comparator gives beta=n modp^12 and the three proxy congruences modp^40. The beta-only comparator gives beta=n modp^12.

proofs.section: Exact source interface and Local conclusion

conventions: The constant-left norm path excludes negative odd raw valuations; no ordinary-prime assumption is used in soundness.
The paired tests epsilon*b and a+b*theta handle nonintegral coefficients. The root-error test selects one split embedding; already-conjugated common data are not conjugated again.

arithmetic_lemmas.label: lem:quartic-height19-anchor
arithmetic_lemmas.title: Scalar height and the 25-squaring anchor
arithmetic_lemmas.statement: The specified scalar batch and anchor imply s in2*3^(2^24-1)Z minus{0}, h(beta)<=H19*|s|^(19/32)<|s|/40, |s|>(24H19)^10, |s|>(40H19)^(32/13), |s|>40 and log(40H19)<|s|/40.
conventions: The unchanged two-predicate anchor has C=3^(2^25), built by25 squarings. No norm-combined anchor is used.
The scalar rational orders are(1,1,1,1,32,32); use all places including inert primes and the unchanged scalar contact polynomial.
The binary lower bound is log2|s|>25165822.5; its comparisons are strict. The anchor subgroup permits arbitrary additional fixed divisibility.

arithmetic_lemmas.label: lem:quartic-selective-lucas-growth
arithmetic_lemmas.title: Twenty-nine positions force the Lucas equation
arithmetic_lemmas.statement: The full comparisons at the five common positions and the24 S,T,Z-specific positions force Delta=t^2-s(s-2)tz+(s-2)^2z^2-1=0 and |t|>exp(|s|-3).
conventions: Use B_L=max(|s|,|t|,|z|), not the maximum involving n.
If Delta is nonzero, the direct heights give B_L^(1/10)<22H19<24H19, contradicting |s|>(24H19)^10.
The inherited Lucas lemma supplies growth of |t| itself.

arithmetic_lemmas.label: lem:quartic-beta-only
arithmetic_lemmas.title: The beta-only source is sound
arithmetic_lemmas.statement: The selected29-full/8-beta assignment implies beta=n and rational input X is an integer.
conventions: All37 positions retain beta congruences, so all eight height coefficients are controlled by N=abs(num(beta-n)).
The bound logB<(31/200)|s|<|s|-3 contradicts B>=|t|. No comparison of n with the smaller first maximum is assumed.

arithmetic_lemmas.label: thm:quartic-source-arithmetic
arithmetic_lemmas.title: The selected source has rational input projection Z
arithmetic_lemmas.statement: The H19/high40/beta12/anchor25/scalar32 guarded-affine37-contact source with full positions0..4 and13..36 and beta-only positions5..12 has rational witnesses exactly at integer inputs.
conventions: Choose scalar data and all four root points before the eight rational height coefficients and D0.
Use j=lcm d_(p,2) over all selected primes and choose h_p=0 modd_(p,1), h_p=4 modd_(p,2), h_p=4 modp^(40+v_p(j)). No cross-prime coprimality is assumed.
Exclude h_p=0,4,-4, which supplies every retained affine subtraction guard.
Choose one theta last after all actual field coefficients. Repeated prime occurrences have the same orientation and independent private witnesses.
This is an arithmetic source reform, not coordinate forgetting from arbitrary released12504 witness tuples.

arithmetic_lemmas.label: lem:quartic-compressed-primary
arithmetic_lemmas.title: Rational equivalence of compressed primary charts
arithmetic_lemmas.statement: The rows f=u^2,v^2+df=1,p^2=x-Df,xf=1, Lambda*p0=G0, Bi=Ci*pi,Bi*Lambda=Gi are equivalent to the full retained primary charts and reciprocal ratios on every fixed external input.

Restore y=xp,z=-1/p,h=up,w=up/v,L=zG; Lambda=-L0. All affine difference guards and field values are retained.
No primary v or u deletion, Jacobi chart, or single-x kernel theorem is used.

arithmetic_lemmas.label: lem:quartic-compressed-primary
arithmetic_lemmas.title: Exact G9 and G2 circuit evaluation
arithmetic_lemmas.statement: Precision40 uses w=Df^2,w2=w^2,w3=w2*w and U6=(a3+a4*w+a5*w2+w3*(a6+a7*w+a8*w2+a9*w3))/a6, yielding G9=a0+a1*w+a2*w2+a6*w3*U6. Precision12 uses G2=1+a1*w+a2*w^2.
conventions: This is the unnumbered exact-circuit paragraph immediately after the compressed-primary lemma.
a6=-418/16575 is a nonzero rational constant; the circuit has scale1. Every residual is quadratic in bound coordinates.
The complete source checker separately binds this exact block3/a6 evaluation and its consumers; approximation is not used to infer polynomial identity.
